title: pseudo-fumaria minor
intro: Pseudo-fumaria minor, commonly known as lesser celandine, is a perennial plant belonging to the Papaveraceae family. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, soothing digestive issues, and acting as a natural diuretic. The therapeutic actions of lesser celandine are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, improve liver function, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Pseudo-fumaria minor include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
